resources.title: T-SQL Chapter Query Pattern Reference
resources.description: A single compiled SQL file collecting the real query shape taught in every chapter — SELECT basics, filtering, joins, aggregation, string/date functions, subqueries/CTEs/views, stored procedures and MERGE, transactions and error handling, window/ranking functions, SARGable indexing patterns, key constraints, and the warehouse fact/dimension join — organized chapter by chapter so you can find and adapt the exact pattern you need without hunting back through lesson guides.

resources.title: AdventureWorks Schema Quick Reference
resources.description: A lookup sheet for the real tables and columns this course's own labs query — Person.Person, HumanResources.Employee, Production.Product/ProductSubcategory/ProductCategory/ProductInventory/BillOfMaterials, and Sales.SalesOrderHeader/SalesOrderDetail in AdventureWorks2012, plus FactInternetSales, DimProduct, and DimCustomer in AdventureWorksDW2014 — with the genuine column names, types, and relationships, not a simplified stand-in schema.

resources.title: T-SQL Style & Object-Naming Cheat Sheet
resources.description: This course's own formatting rules from Lesson 10 (uppercase keywords, one clause per line, two-part schema.table naming), the clause-evaluation-order table from Lesson 40, the usp_/vw_ object-naming prefixes, named-parameter call notation, THROW-over-RAISERROR guidance, and the SARGable rewrite patterns from Chapter 10 — all on one page to check a script against before calling it done.

resources.title: Data Project Review Rubric
resources.description: A five-dimension rubric (correctness, testing, documentation, performance awareness, maintainability) for reviewing a finished query, stored procedure, or small project against a real professional standard. Shared across the Analytics Engineer path's courses.
